title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Exodus 40: Moses raises up the tabernacle and the cloud and glory of Yahweh fill it.

questions.text: On which day did Yahweh tell Moses to raise up the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: "On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting."

answers.text: The first day of the first month
The tenth day of the seventh month
The fifteenth day of the first month
The first day of the seventh month

questions.text: Where was the basin to be set?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and to put water in it.

answers.text: Inside the tent, right in front of the veil
Between the Tent of Meeting and the altar
Beside the ark of the covenant
Outside the gate of the court

questions.text: What was Moses to do with Aaron and his sons at the door of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: "You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water."

answers.text: Cut their hair
Give each of them a staff
Wash them with water
Count them by name

questions.text: In which year was the tabernacle raised up?
questions.explanation: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

answers.text: The first year
The third year
The fortieth year
The second year

questions.text: What did Moses put into the ark?
questions.explanation: He took and put the covenant into the ark, set the poles on the ark and put the mercy seat above on it.

answers.text: The anointing oil
The covenant
The show bread
Aaron's holy garments

questions.text: Where did Moses put the table in the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: He put the table on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

answers.text: On the north side, outside the veil
On the south side, inside the veil
On the east side, by the door
On the west side, behind the ark

questions.text: What did Moses, Aaron and his sons wash at the basin?
questions.explanation: Moses, Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

answers.text: Their holy garments
Their faces and their hair
The vessels of the altar of burnt offering
Their hands and their feet

questions.text: Why was Moses not able to enter the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Moses wasn't able to enter because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh's glory filled the tabernacle.

answers.text: Aaron had forbidden him to go in
The screen of the door had not yet been hung up
The cloud stayed on it and Yahweh's glory filled it
He had not yet washed his hands and feet

questions.text: When did the children of Israel travel onward?
questions.explanation: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, they went onward; if it wasn't taken up, they didn't travel.

answers.text: When the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle
On the first day of every month
Whenever Moses chose a new place to camp
When the fire in the cloud went out

questions.text: What was seen in the cloud by night?
questions.explanation: The cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.

answers.text: Stars
Fire
Lightning
An angel
